title: Auth: axum extractor for Role injection
description:
Implement axum FromRequestParts extractor that calls authorize() and injects (Role, Identity) into every JMAP handler.

**What:** axum extractor living in kithd that extracts ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>, calls authorize(), and either returns the (Role, Identity) pair or converts AuthError to HTTP 4xx/5xx.

**Algorithm:**
1. Add to kithd/Cargo.toml: axum dep (already workspace), also need kith-core, kith-tslocal, kith-store deps
2. Create struct in kithd/src/extractors.rs:
   pub struct Caller { pub role: Role, pub identity: Identity }
3. Implement FromRequestParts<AppState> for Caller where AppState contains:
   - Arc<LocalApiClient>
   - Arc<Store>
   - owner_id: String
4. In from_request_parts():
   a. Extract ConnectInfo<SocketAddr> from parts.extensions
      - If missing: return 500 (server misconfiguration)
   b. Get AppState from parts via Extension<Arc<AppState>>
   c. Call authorize(addr, &state.ts, &state.store, &state.owner_id).await
   d. Map errors:
      - AuthError::NoPeerAddr → 500 Internal Server Error
      - AuthError::WhoIsFailed(_) → 500 Internal Server Error
      - AuthError::Unauthorized → 401 Unauthorized (body: {"type":"unauthorized"})
   e. Return Ok(Caller { role, identity })
5. Router must use .into_make_service_with_connect_info::<SocketAddr>() for ConnectInfo to work

**Defensive rules:**
- 401 response body must NOT include the user_id or WhoIs error detail
- 500 response body must NOT include internal error strings (no info leak)
- Never return 200 on auth failure — all error paths must return non-2xx
- No unwrap() in from_request_parts

**Crate:** kithd/src/extractors.rs (new file)

**Agent team:** Researcher (read axum 0.8 FromRequestParts in ~/.cargo/registry, kith-tslocal lib.rs, kith-core auth.rs) + Implementer + Tester

**Tests (oracle = axum test utilities + hand-constructed WhoIs responses):**
- owner_extractor: MockConnectInfo + mock WhoIs → Caller{role: Owner}
- peer_extractor: MockConnectInfo + mock WhoIs returning contact → Caller{role: Peer}  
- unauthorized_extractor: MockConnectInfo + mock WhoIs returning unknown → HTTP 401 body has no user_id
- whois_fail_extractor: mock WhoIs returns error → HTTP 500 body has no error detail
- no_connect_info: request without ConnectInfo → HTTP 500
